source_title: Tyypin 2 diabetes (Käypä hoito)
candidate_claim: Finnish professional guidance considers prevention, diagnosis, family history and clinical measurements. It applies to Finland's clinical setting, not everyone of Finnish ancestry.

source_title: Actualización en el tratamiento dietético de la prediabetes y diabetes tipo 2
candidate_claim: Spanish scientific societies review dietary management for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. Country-specific dietary practice does not imply a genetic Mediterranean diet response.

source_title: National Guidelines for the Management of Diabetes Mellitus
candidate_claim: Ghanaian clinicians developed local guidance spanning recognition, screening and care. It is a Ghana healthcare document, not evidence about every West African ancestry group.

source_title: SEMDSA: Management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
candidate_claim: South African professional guidance is available, but the listed type 2 diabetes edition is older. It should not be represented as the current best guidance without a version check.

source_title: 中国糖尿病防治指南（2024版）
candidate_claim: Chinese Diabetes Society guidance covers screening, diabetes diagnosis and prevention in China. It does not establish a personalized threshold from Chinese ancestry alone.

source_title: 糖尿病診療ガイドライン2024
candidate_claim: Japanese Diabetes Society guidance reviews diabetes prevention, diagnosis and nutrition. Local clinical recommendations are not an automatic rule for all Japanese-ancestry users.

source_title: Korean Diabetes Association consensus on screening and diabetes care
candidate_claim: The Korean Diabetes Association recommends screening from age 35, or from 19 with risk factors, in its Korean clinical setting. This is not an instruction for this visitor to order tests.

source_design_and_version: Government multi-state population study; ICMR-INDIAB national research
source_title: Indian Council of Medical Research: INDIAB study overview
candidate_claim: The INDIAB program maps pronounced state, urban-rural and metabolic-health variation within India. India is not one uniform ethnic or diabetes-risk population.

source_title: Pakistan Endocrine Society: Type 2 Diabetes and Cardiometabolic Syndrome Guidelines
candidate_claim: Pakistan-authored guidance considers diabetes screening and broader cardiometabolic management. Its applicability depends on the patient's clinical setting.

source_title: แนวทางเวชปฏิบัติสำหรับโรคเบาหวาน 2566
candidate_claim: Thailand's clinical societies developed locally adapted diabetes guidance. The guidance concerns Thai health services rather than inherited risk for every Thai-descended person.

source_title: Pedoman Nasional Pelayanan Klinis Tatalaksana Diabetes Melitus Tipe 2 Dewasa
candidate_claim: The Indonesian Ministry of Health issued an updated type 2 diabetes care guideline in April 2026. It is specific to Indonesian clinical practice.

source_design_and_version: Ministry of Health national guideline; 2020 (6th edition; check updates)
source_title: Management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, 6th edition
candidate_claim: Malaysia's published clinical practice guideline covers local healthcare management; a later edition should be checked before translating detailed recommendations.

source_title: TỶ LỆ TUÂN THỦ ĐIỀU TRỊ VÀ CÁC YẾU TỐ LIÊN QUAN Ở NGƯỜI BỆNH ĐÁI THÁO ĐƯỜNG TYPE 2
candidate_claim: A Vietnamese clinical study investigated diabetes treatment adherence in one Ho Chi Minh City outpatient setting. A clinic sample is not a national prevalence estimate or an ancestry-based risk model.

source_title: Arab Diabetes Forum: clinical practice recommendations for diabetes
candidate_claim: Experts from several Arab countries developed regionally informed guidance. This does not mean Levantine and Gulf populations are clinically interchangeable.

source_title: Saudi Heart Association: cardiovascular diseases and diabetes mellitus
candidate_claim: Saudi clinicians review cardiovascular and diabetes care for the Saudi healthcare context. It provides education about comorbidities, not an ancestry-specific prediction.

source_title: PRONAM: Diabetes tipo 2 y síndrome metabólico
candidate_claim: Mexico's federal medical-care protocol is relevant to care in Mexico, not automatically to the risk of all Mexican or Mexican-American individuals.

source_title: Consumo de refrescos y diabetes mellitus en una comunidad Mazahua Otomí
candidate_claim: Research examines diabetes, soft-drink consumption and other factors in one Mazahua–Otomí community. It cannot be generalized to all Mesoamerican Indigenous peoples.

source_title: Diagnóstico de diabetes mellitus — Sociedade Brasileira de Diabetes
candidate_claim: Brazilian guidance cautions against counting ethnicity as an independent screening factor in Brazil due to extensive population admixture. Brazil does not stand for all South America.

source_title: Diabetes Canada: Type 2 Diabetes and Indigenous Peoples
candidate_claim: Canadian guidance emphasizes Indigenous-led, culturally safe and locally adapted care. It should not be reduced to a genetic-risk explanation.

source_title: A common Greenlandic TBC1D4 variant confers muscle insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes
candidate_claim: A TBC1D4 variant was associated with diabetes risk among people carrying two copies in a Greenlandic cohort. Self-reported Inuit ancestry does not identify anyone's genotype.

source_design_and_version: Ministry of Health local guideline; English; 2024.
source_title: Samoa Ministry of Health National Diabetes Guidelines
candidate_claim: Samoa adapted diabetes clinical guidance to its healthcare context. Samoan ancestry does not by itself establish personal diabetes risk.

source_design_and_version: Professional-society screening guidance; English; Current online clinical guidance; verify version.
source_title: NZSSD: Screening for diabetes in asymptomatic adults
candidate_claim: New Zealand screening guidance explicitly considers Māori, Pacific and South Asian populations. It applies within New Zealand's healthcare system, not as an automatic diaspora testing instruction.

source_title: Australian Type 2 Diabetes Risk Assessment Tool (AUSDRISK)
candidate_claim: Australia's validated risk-tool materials include Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander context along with age, family history and measured factors. Ancestry alone is not a calculated risk score here.

source_design_and_version: 2025 edition / Jan 2026 publication; English/Japanese; National professional guideline
source_title: JSH2025 Japanese Society of Hypertension guideline
candidate_claim: Japanese-authored JSH2025 guidance emphasizes standardized home and office blood-pressure measurement; appraise the locally validated contexts before any educational note. Do not assign a personal target from ancestry.

source_title: Indonesian Ministry of Health national hypertension guideline
candidate_claim: The Indonesian Ministry of Health issued a 2026 adult hypertension clinical standard. It is a national care-context guideline, not a genotype-based finding about all Indonesian/Malaysian ancestry.

source_title: ISH/PASCAR 2026 African-region hypertension guidance
candidate_claim: African regional experts propose simplified culturally and resource-adapted hypertension protocols. The publication is regional and cannot determine blood-pressure recommendations for any person's ancestry alone.

source_design_and_version: 2025 focused update to 2022 guideline; Japanese; Professional guideline
source_title: Japan Atherosclerosis Society adult FH focus update
candidate_claim: The Japan Atherosclerosis Society's 2025 focused familial-hypercholesterolemia update concerns a specific inherited lipid disorder and part of its prior guidance; it is not identical to nonspecific elevated cholesterol.

source_design_and_version: 2024 update; published 2025; Chinese/English; National expert guideline
source_title: 2024 update of Chinese gout and hyperuricemia guidelines
candidate_claim: Chinese professional experts updated gout/hyperuricemia management recommendations based on local evidence. Apparent drug and serum-urate recommendations are for clinicians, not ancestry-based user instructions.

source_design_and_version: 2018 full version; 2022 supplement; Japanese and English summary; National society guideline
source_title: Japanese Society of Gout and Uric & Nucleic Acids guideline 3rd edition
candidate_claim: The Japanese society maintains gout and hyperuricemia guidance with errata and later supplements; confirm exact version/meaning before displaying any difference with international guidance.

source_title: Genetic and environmental factors associated with lactose digestion in African populations
candidate_claim: Lactase-persistence mechanisms and dairy tolerance vary substantially among African populations, including eastern pastoralist groups. LCT genotype, lactase nonpersistence and symptomatic lactose intolerance must not be conflated.

source_design_and_version: 2016; English (Indian-led research); Large multi-region population study
source_title: Prevalence of adult celiac disease in India: regional variations and associations
candidate_claim: Indian research found regional differences in celiac markers and disease outcomes correlated with regional wheat intake, not a simple HLA ancestry gradient. Verify the distinct study definitions, sizes and diagnostic methods.

source_title: Epidemiology of Celiac Disease in Western Iran during 2019–2021
candidate_claim: An Iranian medical-center study describes confirmed celiac presentations in Kermanshah, not national prevalence; review ascertainment and whether a specific regional note is justified.

source_title: EASL Clinical Practice Guidelines on haemochromatosis
candidate_claim: European haemochromatosis guidance distinguishes genotype, serum iron phenotypes, penetrance and regional HFE variation. It does not support diagnosing iron overload from ethnicity.

source_design_and_version: 2025; English (Brazilian-led research); Brazilian clinical genetics review/proposal
source_title: Iron overload is not the same everywhere — Brazilian researcher proposal
candidate_claim: Brazilian researchers report a different distribution of iron-overload genetic causes from some European cohorts and propose adapted investigation; verify strength, case sampling and limits before any South America label.

source_title: Hemocromatose — Portuguese Journal of Internal Medicine
candidate_claim: A Portuguese medical review describes phenotype-led hemochromatosis evaluation, variable penetrance and genetic heterogeneity; do not infer genotype or diagnosis from Iberian/Mediterranean heritage.
